requirements.notes: AUTOMATED and this change's crux. BC-WALK-01: walkway comfort is an absolute human dimension in fixed mm and must NEVER scale with M. Proven three ways: (1) the rating engine (rateWalkway) takes only a clearance and compares it against module-free WALKWAY_THRESHOLDS constants; (2) WalkwayBlock takes NO module prop — there is no code path by which M could reach the rating — verified as the crux by all three fresh Checkers (review-findings.json verdict clean, 0 findings); (3) the "thresholds are fixed mm, independent of module" unit test pins the boundaries with no module argument. The spec scenario 'changing M from 700 to 350 leaves every rating unchanged' holds by construction because M is not an input to the block. The read-only recompute-from-room render is DOM-level (ADR-0001), but module-independence is a structural/tested property, not a render property.
